title: Ops Play Labs - Exec Brief and OKR Crafting Notes (draft)
body:
Purpose
- Rapid, practical playbook for the upcoming company All-Hands + Exec update week.
- Use the Ops Play Labs session to: 1) align cross-functional leadership on a prioritized OKR slate, 2) rehearse exec talking points, and 3) produce a lightweight decision heatmap for follow-ups.

Audience
- Execs, direct reports across Eng/Product/CS/GTMs, site reliability and ops leads. Primary authors: company-ops, product, eng leadership.

Desired outcomes (for the week)
1) Finalize top 4 company objectives for the next quarter and surface 2–3 measurable KRs per objective.
2) Produce a 20-minute CEO exec update + 10-minute CTO deep-dive with clear asks.
3) Publish an actionable all-hands run-of-show and a 10-item decision heatmap with owners and SLA for closure.

High-level schedule (this sprint)
- Day 0 (prep): Ops Play Labs internal rehearsal (leadership only) — validate metrics slide deck, finalize asks.
- Day 1: Exec update rehearsal + okr craft session (2 hours). Deliverable: draft OKR sheet + prioritized tradeoffs.
- Day 2: All-hands run-of-show finalization + comms draft. Deliverable: published agenda + employee FAQ.
- Day 3: Post-all-hands decision triage and assignment. Deliverable: decision heatmap + JIRA epics created.

Draft OKRs (working drafts — focus on explicit measurable signals)
Objective A: Make inference costs predictable and 2x more efficient for typical PLG workloads
- KR A1: Reduce median per-request cost for text-generation baseline by 35% vs current quarter (measured on hosted-api calls).
- KR A2: Increase cache hit ratio for common prefixes to >= 45% in production for top 10 customers.
- KR A3: Ship two automated quantization profiles and validate with A/B quality guard rails (>=95% quality pass on eval prompts).

Objective B: Improve platform reliability and reduce user-visible latency regressions
- KR B1: Achieve 99.95% uptime for hosted inference endpoints (monthly rolling).
- KR B2: Cut 95th pct request latency by 20ms for short-form chat workloads (<= 64 tokens).
- KR B3: Reduce incident-to-resolution median time by 30% via runbook automation and alert tuning.

Objective C: Shorten experiment-to-production cycle for model rollouts
- KR C1: Decrease average model rollout cycle from canary to full by 50% while preserving quality guard rails.
- KR C2: Expand end-to-end eval coverage to include 5 production prompt sets for canary gating.
- KR C3: Deliver SDK changes to support function-calling type safety and rollouts in 1.0 client.

Objective D: Expand enterprise adoption and private deployments
- KR D1: Close 3 Dedicated or Private contracts worth > $500k ARR combined.
- KR D2: Deliver VPC onboarding checklist reducing time-to-onboard for security review from 8->3 weeks.
- KR D3: Ship KMS/HSM integration template and 2 enterprise customer pilots.

Notes on OKR crafting (internal heuristics)
- Keep objectives externally framed (customer or product outcome) and KRs measurable.
- Max 4 objectives at company level — avoid laundry lists.
- Ensure at least one KR ties directly to unit economics (per-token cost or throughput/cost).
- Each KR needs a technical owner and one GTM owner for commercial alignment.

All-hands run-of-show (compact)
- 00:00–00:05: Welcome & recap (CEO) — 3 quick wins from last quarter.
- 00:05–00:25: Exec update (CEO) — state of business, headline metrics, ask to org.
- 00:25–00:35: CTO deep-dive (CTO) — serving runtime improvements & roadmap impact.
- 00:35–00:45: Product snapshot (Head of Product) — hosted/dedicated/private signals.
- 00:45–00:55: Customer story (CS) — short case showing Dedicated value.
- 00:55–01:05: Ops Play Labs highlights (company-ops) — decision heatmap and next steps.
- 01:05–01:20: Live Q&A (moderated; collect questions via Slido).

Exec Update talking points (CEO + CTO) — rehearsal bullets
- CEO: growth trajectory + ARR health; top resource asks (Dedicated capacity investment + sales enablement). One slide: ARR, retention, top 20 customer spend, runway impact of hires.
- CTO: Explain tradeoff decisions made by ops play labs — where we will accept slight latency increases to halve cost for cold-start volumes; call out safe fallbacks. One slide: measurable impact and rollback plan.

Decision heatmap (format + example entries)
- Heatmap row: decision name | impact (high/med/low) | confidence | owner | target close date | follow-ups (Jira keys).
- Example: "Autopromote model-variants" | impact: high | confidence: med | owner: Diego Martinez | close: 2025-03-15 | follow-up: OPS-812.

Risks and proposed mitigations
- Risk: Quality regressions with quantized profiles. Mitigation: mandatory eval gating + 3rd-party human spot-checks for top 10 prompts.
- Risk: Delayed enterprise onboarding due to legal/KMS requirements. Mitigation: template legal artifacts + prioritized SSO/KMS backlog.
- Risk: Overcommit of Dedicated capacity vs demand. Mitigation: step-in capacity contracts and burst policy SLOs.

Open questions for leadership workshop
- Which objective is prioritized if we must drop one: cost-efficiency vs enterprise expansion?
- What’s the threshold for automated rollback on quantization experiments (quality delta)?
- What dedicated capacity guarantee are we willing to price into starter contracts?

Post-all-hands follow-ups (first 10 actions)
1) Publish OKR draft to Confluence + send to org (owner: Maya Chen) — due 2025-03-07.
2) Create JIRA epic for each company KR (owner: Liam O'Connor) — due 2025-03-09.
3) Finalize comms FAQ and publish intranet page (owner: Sofia Rinaldi) — due 2025-03-06.
4) Set up weekly OKR sync cadences and calendar invites (owner: Asha Patel) — due 2025-03-05.
5) Run three customer outreach calls to validate Dedicated asks (owner: Diego Martinez) — due 2025-03-21.
6) Instrument dashboard for KR A1 (cost) and KR B2 (latency) with owners (owner: Eng Observability) — due 2025-03-12.
7) Ship first quantization profile alpha with gating (owner: Applied ML) — due 2025-04-01.
8) Prepare a rollback playbook for any rollout that increases 95p latency by >20ms (owner: SRE) — due 2025-03-20.
9) Pilot KMS integration template with one enterprise prospect (owner: Solutions Eng) — due 2025-04-15.
10) Post all-hands decision heatmap to company JIRA board and tag owners (owner: company-ops) — due 2025-03-08.

Appendix: quick metric snapshot (current baselines to reference in rehearsals)
- Hosted API median per-request cost (baseline): $0.0096/token-equivalent (internal calc).
- Cache hit ratio (top 10 customers): 23%.
- Monthly hosted endpoints uptime (last 30 days): 99.86%.
- Average model rollout cycle: 18 days (canary->full).

Appendix: rehearsal checklist
- Slides: limit to 6 slides per speaker; include 1 slide with explicit asks.
- Rehearse live demo paths offline (no network dependencies).
- Confirm Slido + captioning + accessibility notes.
- Prepare 2 backup slides per speaker for follow-up questions.

Notes to self
- Keep language crisp: avoid technical deep dives in CEO slot. Reserve 10 minutes for CTO.
- Ask: can we get a short customer quote from the Dedicated pilot to open the product snapshot? Reach out to CS now.
- Don't forget to update linked artifact list with final Confluence page and PR links.

Revisions log
- 2025-03-01 initial draft by Asha Patel.
- 2025-03-03 added rehearsal checklist and metric baselines (Liam O'Connor).
- 2025-03-05 incorporated pilot follow-up owners and tightened KRs (Maya Chen).
